= PGVector
:artifactid: camel-pgvector-starter

Store, delete and search vector embeddings in a PostgreSQL table with the pgvector extension.

== What's inside

* xref:{csb-camel-components}::pgvector-component.adoc[PGVector component], URI syntax: `pgvector:collection`

Please refer to the above links for usage and configuration details.

== Maven coordinates

[source,xml]
----
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.camel.springboot</groupId>
    <artifactId>camel-pgvector-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>
----

== Spring Boot Auto-Configuration

The starter supports 7 options, which are listed below.

[width="100%",cols="2,5,^1,2",options="header"]
|===
| Name | Description | Default | Type
| camel.component.pgvector.action | The action to perform. The CamelPgVectorAction header, when set, wins over this option. |  | PgVectorAction
| camel.component.pgvector.autowired-enabled | Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc. | true | Boolean
| camel.component.pgvector.configuration | The configuration shared by the endpoints of the component. Each endpoint uses a copy of it, which its own options then change. The option is a org.apache.camel.component.pgvector.PgVectorConfiguration type. |  | PgVectorConfiguration
| camel.component.pgvector.dimension | The number of dimensions of the embedding column that CREATE_TABLE creates, as vector(n). It must match the size of the vectors of the embedding model, as PostgreSQL rejects a vector of another size. The other actions do not use it. | 384 | Integer
| camel.component.pgvector.distance-type | The distance function of SIMILARITY_SEARCH and of the HNSW index that CREATE_INDEX creates: COSINE (cosine distance), EUCLIDEAN (L2 distance) or INNER_PRODUCT (the negative inner product, so the closest records have the lowest distance). A search uses the index only when both use the same distance type. | cosine | PgVectorDistanceType
| camel.component.pgvector.enabled | Whether to enable auto configuration of the pgvector component. This is enabled by default. |  | Boolean
| camel.component.pgvector.lazy-start-producer | Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing. | false | Boolean
